notes.title: Word usage
notes.pattern: Nを学びます / Nに教わります / Nから学びます
notes.explanation: 学ぶ is learning through study or experience; 教わる emphasizes receiving instruction from someone, marked with に. 教育 is education as a process or system. 教科書 is a textbook. 課 here means a lesson or section, as in 次の課. A teacher, textbook and experience can all be sources of learning.

notes.explanation: 実力 is actual ability or competence. 実績 is a record of results already achieved. 発揮する means show or exercise an ability; を marks the ability or strength put to use. Being able to do something and having a record of doing it are related but different.
